hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: The customer quickly secures tangible value for their 1,500 expiring points with a single tap, smoothly re-engaging after a period of inactivity.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer returns after 41 days of inactivity and discovers 1,500 points are set to expire within 7 days.
hypotheses.storyTension: Risk of losing accumulated value without feeling pressured or bombarded by intrusive alerts.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Customer browses a clean instant reward grid and redeems points for an immediate tangible voucher.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Immediate, satisfying claim of instant rewards using expiring points.

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: The customer utilizes a frictionless quick-redeem carousel to claim a familiar small reward using available balances.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer opens the rewards overview looking for straightforward, low-effort ways to use balances.
hypotheses.storyTension: Friction and cognitive fatigue from navigating complex loyalty catalogs after a hiatus.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Customer selects from a curated quick-redeem carousel matching past coffee and snack voucher preferences.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Frictionless engagement with zero-friction instant reward options.
